All other code in this distribution (Dependencies/Foundation/*.cs,
Dependencies/SubModule.cs, Dependencies/AliasStubSubModule.cs,
Dependencies/EarlyLog.cs) is written by TAOM and MIT-licensed. The paragraph
below qualifies where that code's design came from.

The defensive infrastructure classes in Dependencies/Foundation/
(DiagLog, RuntimeLog, ReflectionUtils, VersionProbe, IncompatibleModDetector,
PatchShield, SaveShield, FailureRecord, FailedModsCatalog,
SubModuleConstructionGuard, CollectAssemblyTypesShim) are TAOM
re-implementations. Their design and behaviour were derived from reading the
corresponding classes in BetaDeps.Foundation
(https://www.nexusmods.com/mountandblade2bannerlord/mods/11274), which was used
as a reference while they were written. No BetaDeps source files were copied into
TAOM; the class names and the shielded-method and simple-type lists do follow the
upstream's. TAOM's versions differ in substance: several carry notes recording
where the BetaDeps original was wrong for this engine version and what TAOM does
instead.

The ModulesToLoadAfterThis list in Dependencies/_Module/SubModule.xml is adapted
from BetaDeps v0.7.5.1's. It is a list of module ids, which are compatibility
facts about other people's mods rather than expression.

Copyright (c) 2026 TAOM project contributors, licensed under the MIT License.
